function.name: change_appointment
function.description: Move or cancel a visit from find_my_appointment, only after the caller said yes to that visit. action=reschedule copies the visit's details into this call (result: saved with state.revision and rescheduling); then call search_slots and offer a window as usual: when the caller agrees, confirm_booking books the new window and releases the old one in the same step (result replaced). action=cancel needs the caller's explicit yes to cancelling that visit; result cancelled with its spoken window. Never say a visit is moved before confirm_booking returns booked, or cancelled before this returns cancelled.

expected_revision.description: Latest state.revision (0 if nothing saved yet).

caller_quote.description: The caller's own words agreeing to move or cancel this visit.

bot_say.description: Spoken to the caller while this runs: one brief, natural acknowledgment (2-6 words) that fits this moment, e.g. "Okay, one moment". Vary it from your last one. In the caller's current language. No trailing punctuation.
